name: Gakuto
source:
Competing with Takigawa to be the most popular, he is another pride of Ohgiya. He is confident and rugged. Possessing a strength that cannot be restrained, he still sometimes shows an emotional side that is starved for love.

(Taken from the [url=https://d3p.co.jp/ohgiya/en/]official English website[/url])
